# Introduction

This report provides a standardized survey of transcriptomic datasets (bulk RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, and snRNA-seq) associated with Heart Failure with preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF).

# Metadata Dictionary

The repository consolidates biological metadata, experimental designs, and sequencing specifications to streamline bioinformatics workflows and comparative analyses.

# Repositories Overview

```{python}
#| label: calculate-metrics
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
from datetime import date

# 1.Load the datasets from google sheets:
url_human = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YTe8AkWDHRS-WPOq0ZIrlfv2Q_bPDlUavvhNmwOCyuo/export?format=csv&gid=1105806498"
df_human = pd.read_csv(url_human, header=1)
df_human["Species_Group"] = "Homo sapiens"

url_mus = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YTe8AkWDHRS-WPOq0ZIrlfv2Q_bPDlUavvhNmwOCyuo/export?format=csv&gid=982375450"
df_mus = pd.read_csv(url_mus, header=1)
df_mus["Species_Group"] = "Mus musculus"

url_felis = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YTe8AkWDHRS-WPOq0ZIrlfv2Q_bPDlUavvhNmwOCyuo/export?format=csv&gid=1317070655"
df_felis = pd.read_csv(url_felis, header=1)
df_felis["Species_Group"] = "Felis catus"

# 2. Unification and cleaning  of empty rows
df_all = pd.concat([df_human, df_mus, df_felis], ignore_index=True)
df_all = df_all.dropna(subset=["Dataset_ID"])
df_all = df_all[df_all["Dataset_ID"].astype(str).str.strip() != ""]

# 3. Calculate metrics
total_datasets = len(df_all)
total_species = df_all["Species_Group"].nunique()
data_update = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
```

## Human Models (*Homo sapiens*)

### Biological & Technical Landscape

```{python}

#| label: fig-human-omics
#| fig-cap: "Interactive exploration of technical metadata"

import plotly.express as px

# Ommics distribution counting
omics_counts_human = df_human["Omics_Approach"].value_counts().reset_index()
omics_counts_human.columns = ["Approach", "Count"]

# Cria o gráfico de rosca interativo

fig = px.pie(
    omics_counts_human,
    values="Count",
    names="Approach",
    hole=0.45,
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Prism,
    title="Omics Approach Distribution",
)

fig.update_layout(margin=dict(t=30, b=20, l=0, r=0))
fig.show()
```
:::

::: {layout-ncol=2}
```{python}
#| label: fig-human-platform
#| fig-cap: "Sequencing plataforms utilized"

platform_counts = df_human["Platform"].value_counts().reset_index()
platform_counts.columns = ["Platform", "Count"]

fig_plat = px.bar(
    platform_counts,
    x="Platform",
    y="Count",
    color="Platform",
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Pastel,
    title="Sequencing platforms",
)
fig_plat.update_layout(showlegend=False, margin=dict(t=30, b=20, l=0, r=0))
fig_plat.show()
```

:::

```{python}

#| label: fig-human-processed
#| fig-cap: "Processed data availability."

processed_counts = df_human["Processed_Data_Avaiability"].value_counts().reset_index()
processed_counts.columns = ["Status", "Count"]

fig_proc = px.pie(
    processed_counts,
    values="Count",
    names="Status",
    hole=0.45,
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Set2,
    title="Processed Data Status",
)
fig_proc.update_layout(margin=dict(t=30, b=20, l=0, r=0))
fig_proc.show()
```
